pr.title: Converge Copilot setup and devcontainer validation
pr.body:
Copilot setup must prepare the repository's complete supported validation environment, including Python and Git hooks. Its validation hooks can fix files before returning failure, and Copilot can start after a setup failure. Setup now runs those hooks in an independent copy so a failed check does not leave their edits in the agent's repository. The devcontainer check also needs to inspect root and nested entries in the complete Git tree, including unusual path names.

This change:

- Acquires the exact event revision with usable history and separately pins main from the fixed anonymous origin. Keeps empty job permissions and verifies that setup does not alter acquired inputs.
- Installs locked Python/Node tools, prepares and checks hooks, and runs full pre-commit validation. Uses a guarded Python 3.12 environment, bounded phases and a 59-minute overall job limit. The full-validation phase has a 45-minute maximum; these are limits, not measured guarantees.
- Runs the same full hook command once in an independent copy of the prepared repository, Git metadata and Node dependencies. Both the current directory and `GITHUB_WORKSPACE` name the copy. The prepared external Python runtime stays in place. Copy/link/Git-state checks and an explicit failed-directory-change guard stop unsafe fallback. Suite failures survive cleanup; interruption can leave a temporary copy without exposing the source files to normal fixer edits. This is a side-effect boundary for ordinary hooks, not a hostile-code sandbox.
- Preserves the finite supported historical capability cases. Declared current layouts still require current inputs. Only the exact undeclared Node 24.18.1/npm 11.16.0 historical tuple may retain the scalar `cd ../.. && husky` preparation command.
- Checks current package locks and parser-policy agreement with the built-in-only preflight before either npm install. A failed check stops both installs; supported declaration-absent history retains its earlier preparation path.
- Places curl's configuration-disable flag first while retaining the existing transport, digest and retry controls. Uses a recursive, NUL-delimited Git tree inventory, including directory entries, for the devcontainer check.
- Expands nine newly authored PowerShell blocks into the guide's brace style. All four PowerShell bodies retain their executable token streams.

The review repairs implement [D12 B99](https://github.com/franklesniak/PSStyleGuide/blob/f582cfc811cb49144c679d5ef3e638940c0fa786/docs/planning/action-items-2026-10-02/results/A03/otbs-review-decision.md) and [D13 P96](https://github.com/franklesniak/PSStyleGuide/blob/f582cfc811cb49144c679d5ef3e638940c0fa786/docs/planning/action-items-2026-10-02/results/A03/validation-isolation-decision.md). D12 applies the required formatting without changing tokens. D13 protects the prepared source files even when a hook changes a file and then fails or the validation process is terminated. Their records contain the validated findings, alternatives, separate weighted rubrics, scores, selected actions, primary references and test limits. Supporting planning records do not replace the implementation or native review evidence.

The preceding selected decisions remain [D8](https://github.com/franklesniak/PSStyleGuide/blob/a60d1fcae8ed6ebceec5db722db0bc8f7a3c0c18/docs/planning/action-items-2026-10-02/results/A03/devcontainer-decisions.md), [D9 and its historical refinement](https://github.com/franklesniak/PSStyleGuide/blob/a60d1fcae8ed6ebceec5db722db0bc8f7a3c0c18/docs/planning/action-items-2026-10-02/results/A03/copilot-setup-decisions.md), [D6](https://github.com/franklesniak/PSStyleGuide/blob/a60d1fcae8ed6ebceec5db722db0bc8f7a3c0c18/docs/planning/action-items-2026-10-02/results/A03/copilot-curl-decision.md), and [D11](https://github.com/franklesniak/PSStyleGuide/blob/e253670510e6108d40f8b180ac944fecda40f70d/docs/planning/action-items-2026-10-02/results/A03/preinstall-policy-decision.md).

Final committed validation: The final all-files pre-commit run passed all 11 hooks with zero skipped hooks. All 75 candidate file identities remained unchanged. Normal repair commit `f2c7f738265df29c123f7d627394c6bba1a5c7d0` has parent `69e1b0d1b0715bfc4025372c7282fe04c38178dc` and tree `c82fa2e11bfe333b9bcaf732bf12d1d9cb907380`. Against accepted base `fb3288934215dfa9a25114cf79ad86e60b5fb107`, the actual accepted-base FinalizeMetadataNow/MetadataClassificationOnly and candidate ProposedPolicy checks passed. The ordinary current dependency audit returned CLEAN with no findings, accepted risk exceptions or unused exceptions. The source worktree is clean.

Focused repair evidence:

- All 23 final affected Linux cases pass with zero skips. They exercise the actual extracted validation body, copy/path/interpreter failures, interrupted cleanup, history/workspace behavior and status propagation. Four negative controls fail their intended assertions when cwd/workspace switching is removed, writable sharing replaces the copy, or failure status is swallowed. A separate before/final check proves a failed directory change returns failure without starting the suite.
- Two actual locked formatting hooks change files and fail inside a Windows/Git Bash copy fixture while the original tracked files, Git state and prepared dependencies remain identical. Two declared Windows path-rendering adaptations leave the production Linux body unchanged. This reduced fixture is not a full-hook or hosted-agent run.
- The real accepted-base checker passes `MetadataClassificationOnly` for base `fb328893` and input `69e1b0d` through the Linux copy wrapper with only suite dispatch substituted. This focused test covers that mode and pair; final-commit endpoint results are stated separately above.
- All four PowerShell bodies have zero parser and applicable PSScriptAnalyzer 1.24.0 findings on PowerShell 7.6.5. Final strict YAML and actionlint checks pass. Root independently reproduced the repair tree and verified preservation of all 73 tracked paths outside the two-file repair.

Earlier evidence is retained at its actual input: 113 affected Linux cases passed before the final cleanup/interpreter/directory-change refinements; the 23-case run covers those refinements. D11 passed 47 affected install-policy tests and its ordering controls. D9 passed 90 affected Copilot cases, six real historical snapshots and 18 mutation controls; D8 passed 145 focused cases and six mutation controls. These are complementary results, not a claim that every earlier suite reran on the final repair.

All 11 ordinary Actions workflows passed on the earlier `69e1b0d` input. Its two actual setup jobs completed full validation in 1,166 and 1,114 seconds. These results do not measure the new copy overhead. Fresh repaired-input hosted installation, timing and review results are pending. Ordinary Actions setup evidence does not establish a separate Copilot agent session.

Capability classification is not accepted-policy authority. Deliberate candidate changes can select an evidenced historical layout; separate accepted-policy checks still govern maintenance. Copilot may start after setup failure, so this workflow is not an agent admission gate. This is the remaining PS source batch after accepted PR #230; Terraform transfer, reverse comparison and full A03 convergence remain separate work.
